steps.message: hey Marko, im Anna. dropped my toast on the floor, mornings going great
enough about my breakfast. how did your weekend go?
im not here to interview you. flirt with me a little
i listen to soul when i cook, what do you normally play?
back now. i left the phone in the kitchen. Nina Simone is usually my first choice
what do you remember about me then?
im going to bed. goodnight, dont message first tonight
